objective: Separate A peripheral/ALLN, B posterior convergence, C basal/reader/body in current protected organism; test new 250–400 ms proposal as exploratory, never relabel old 150–300 ms admission.

review_inputs.historical_PFG_not_current: 20260919 four-arm 335ms, onset 11ms; 300ms post-onset right minus sham +0.01931856 deg, left minus sham -0.00343414, uniform minus sham +0.00863580. Does not establish onset or 400ms response.
review_inputs.external: One ChatGPT request sent with pinned public package and three falsifiable questions; Jev at most one bounded task-routing call.

rivals.A: ORN and ALLN effective input to PN loses or reverses lateral contrast before downstream output. Falsifier: signed receptor-specific PN drive and actual fine/legacy outputs retain proper contrast across trial.
rivals.B: Connected posterior streams into DNa02 transform/cancel correctly signed PN signal. Falsifier: DNa02 consumed input is correctly bilateral and mismatch emerges at reader/body.
rivals.C: Initial/basal state or reader/body mapping dominates odor effect. Falsifier: same prepared baseline plus mirror command produces mirror body and DNa02 input already inverted upstream.

scope: No anatomy editing, gain tuning or new biological parameter. Do not describe unsigned edge counts as signed causal flow or every abstract weighted input as membrane pA. Dedicated observer only; no change to CNS equations.

precommitted_windows.onset_anchor: after fixed 40ms preparation and field installation; trial ms 0

primary_descriptive_metrics: yaw_delta_from_onset_deg by arm and paired contrasts to sham
left-right DNa02 release and signed native input by exact afferent ID/type
per-type signed source contribution with units of inherited rate-model weighted input, not pA
PN input and route-specific output provenance

numerical_controls.observer_on_off: Two 1ms sham smoke loads from identical checkpoint; compare exported neural/body state hashes or exact arrays and accepted/rejected/event counts. Stop if difference.
numerical_controls.reconstruction: For selected nonvisual posts, sum effective signed edge terms plus drive-theta; compare to coefficient target/inverse only where invertible and route is generic. If exact consumed operator inaccessible, label boundary reconstruction proxy and stop causal localization.
numerical_controls.precision: Before mechanism claim, reference/profile check at 20ms and refinement to interpreted endpoint with unchanged 1e-4 tolerance; do not infer from an unqualified numerical prefix.

staged_gate: Run zero-load anatomy/operator audit; implement observer; two 1ms sham on/off. Full four arms only if observer exactness and reconstruction pass. If not, stop with concrete instrument gap rather than interpreting a proxy as current.
stop: Stop after bounded four-arm readout and numeric gate or first failed gate/budget. No selection of window, route or parameters after viewing yaw; failed cohort becomes development, not blind confirmation.
